summary_max: What is the maximum {column} in the dataset?
summary_min: What is the minimum {column} in the dataset?
summary_median: What is the median {column} in the dataset?
summary_mean_rounded: What is the mean {column} in the dataset? Round to 2 decimal places.
summary_count_value: How many rows have {column} equal to '{value}'?
summary_nunique: How many unique values does the '{column}' column have?
summary_nrows: How many rows are in the dataset?
summary_ncols: How many columns are in the dataset?
subset: Return a dataframe with the {columns} of all rows where {conditions}. Assign the result to `df`.
sorted_subset: Return a dataframe with the {columns} of all rows where {conditions}, {sort_phrase}. Assign the result to `df`.
